title: Inter Give No Return Date For Curtis Jones — Sky Says 3-4 Weeks #Shorts
description:
Inter say Curtis Jones has a strain in his right adductors and set no return date. Sky Sport Italia says three to four weeks.
Free daily Inter digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=38

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Inter.it, Oct 8: tests at Humanitas in Rozzano found a myofascial strain in the adductors of Jones's right thigh; no return date, reassessed in the coming days.
REPORTED — Sky Sport Italia via FCInterNews, Oct 8: three to four weeks out, aiming for Como at home; Barella ready to start against Parma with Mkhitaryan beside him, Calhanoglu available again.
REPORTED — Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInterNews, Oct 8: reads it as about 20 days, with Venezia on October 28 or the derby on October 31 as the target.
CONFIRMED — Inter.it, Oct 8: Parma visit San Siro on Saturday, October 10, and the club says the stadium is close to selling out.
